items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Names Cecile Guegan Permanent Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) has appointed Cecile Guegan as its permanent Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President. The company selected Guegan after a competitive search that followed the departure of its previous finance chief. As CFO, Guegan is expected to oversee Pfizer's financial planning, capital allocation policies, and communication with investors and creditors.
